splits.development: Used for tuning retrieval, prompts, and refusal thresholds.
splits.test: Held out until the final comparison. Never used for training.

metrics.retrieval_hit_at_5: Fraction of answerable questions with an accepted supporting article in the top five results.
metrics.unsupported_answer_rate: Fraction of substantive answers containing at least one factual claim unsupported by the supplied evidence.
metrics.refusal_recall: Fraction of unanswerable questions correctly refused.
metrics.false_refusal_rate: Fraction of answerable questions unnecessarily refused.
metrics.answer_correctness: Whether the answer satisfies the reviewed reference criteria.
metrics.citation_support: Whether each cited passage supports its associated claim.
metrics.latency_p95_ms: 95th percentile end-to-end request latency; report cold and warm requests separately.

comparison_rules: Use the same corpus snapshot for each comparable run.
Use identical retrieved evidence when comparing generation models.
Record model versions, prompts, settings, and raw responses.
Report answer coverage alongside unsupported-answer rate.
Check AI judge decisions against human reviews.
Do not report draft or unreviewed questions as benchmark results.
